bf16.positions: 48 through 63 after each of four 64-token prefixes
bf16.limits: Small numerical panel, not a full perplexity or task benchmark. CIRU F16 KV/FA auto; competitor Q8_0 KV/FA on. MTP off. Two independent CIRU loads produce identical raw logits. Other capture-to-CIRU differences are deliberately omitted from this BF16-only table.

scope.humaneval: HumanEval0–9 canonical task text through each embedded non-thinking chat template. Greedy, seed123, one natural-EOS completion per task. MTP acceptance and speed only.
scope.hardware: Two Ryzen AI MAX+395 / Radeon8060S gfx1151 systems with128GB unified memory, NixOS. HE: CIRU on Ciru; Laurent and Unsloth on Sozo, CPU performance governor, no concurrent model load per host. Sweep: all Sozo, powersave governor.
scope.sweep: MTP off, 512–131072 exact source tokens,128 generated tokens,262144 context, erased slot, temp0,seed1234,ignoreEOS. Each package retains its documented sweep settings.
scope.bf16: Small numerical panel, not a full perplexity or task benchmark. CIRU F16 KV/FA auto; competitor Q8_0 KV/FA on. MTP off. Two independent CIRU loads produce identical raw logits. Other capture-to-CIRU differences are deliberately omitted from this BF16-only table.
scope.tg: Aggregate TG = sum(generated_tokens−1) / sum(server predicted seconds), preserving the runtime convention that the first generated token is outside decode timing.
scope.wall: Request wall includes prefill and streamed generation. Panel wall also includes recorder overhead between requests; excludes model loading. Total tokens = prompt + generated.
scope.batch_verification: Pinned Laurent and Unsloth card commands do not override batch/microbatch. Both native binaries report defaults2048/512 via --help. HumanEval retained those defaults; target-only sweeps explicitly specify2048/512. CIRU profile explicitly specifies2048/512.
scope.profile_policy: Use each package’s live recommended serving configuration. All three HumanEval panels have262144-token context. No16K serving profiles or reduced-context diagnostic substitutes.

correction.scope: CIRU HumanEval0–9 rerun at released262144-token context; supersedes earlier16384-token diagnostic configuration. Laurent/Unsloth and BF16/sweep data unchanged.
